name: Inma no Meikyuu Retranslation - Hikyou no Chika Iseki ni, Kodai Bunmei no Injuu o Mita!!
original_name: 淫魔の迷宮 Retranslation 秘境の地下遺跡に、古代文明の淫獣を見た!!
source:
After 17 years, the underground labyrinth and the menace of the lewd beasts are back again!

The main character, "Professor", who is an obsessive archaeologist, and "Akari," a former tomb raider, challenge the labyrinth of a mysterious ancient civilization hidden in the jungles of Southeast Asia! 

A mysterious lewd beast!? Will they be able to return to the surface alive?!

The illustrations, scenario, and BGM have all been revamped, and
Rio Kisaka continues to be the voice actor for the heroine Akari.

Please enjoy the story of the new underground labyrinth where everything has been powered up.
translation:
时隔17年，地下迷宫与淫兽的威胁再度归来！

主角“教授”是一位痴迷考古学的学者。他与曾经的盗墓者明里一同挑战隐藏在东南亚丛林中的神秘古代文明迷宫！

神秘的淫兽现身！？他们能否活着回到地面？

插画、剧本和背景音乐均已全面翻新，女主角明里的配音仍由Kisaka Rio担任。

请尽情体验这座全面升级的全新地下迷宫！
